premises: wl is a messenger-side role set mirroring IWhitelist.isSenderAllowed; the setWhitelist env action is its only writer.
dr (__isL1MessageDropped) is read-only here (replayMessage :195); nothing in this bundle writes it — drop effects live on the queue/drop side (O34 depends on this).

replay.detail: estimateCrossDomainMessageFee(_from, _newGasLimit) keys the whitelist waiver on the original sender, not the replay caller — whitelisted Alice's message replays free from any account, and Bob's whitelist status does not waive Alice's message.
